http-request.name: http-request
http-request.description: Make an HTTP request to any public REST API (GET/POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE) and return { status, ok, headers, body }. To use an API key without exposing it, save it once in this app's settings and reference it as {{NAME}} in the url, a query value, or a header value (e.g. header "api-key: {{BREVO_API_KEY}}", query api_key="{{HUNTER_API_KEY}}", or url ".../{{MAKE_WEBHOOK_TOKEN}}"). Private/internal addresses are blocked (SSRF-safe).

params.url: Full https:// URL (may contain {{SECRET}} placeholders). In production, plain http:// is refused for requests that carry secrets.
params.headers: Request headers. Values may contain {{SECRET}} placeholders. Content-Type defaults to application/json when a body is sent.
params.query: Query-string parameters appended to the URL. Values may contain {{SECRET}} placeholders.
params.body: Raw request body (e.g. a JSON string). Ignored for GET. May contain {{SECRET}} placeholders.
params.timeoutMs: Request timeout in milliseconds (default 30000, min 1000, max 120000).

name: HTTP Request
description: Call any public REST API (GET/POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE) from your agent. Reference stored API keys as {{PLACEHOLDER}} so they never reach the model. Private/internal addresses are blocked (SSRF-safe).
